title: HELIX // DNA Strand Synthesizer
description: Interactive double-helix DNA strand visualization with real-time base pair matching, rotational dynamics, and molecular audio synthesis.

title: FLUX // Electromagnetic Wave Engine
description: Real-time electromagnetic wave propagation simulator with interference patterns, standing waves, and Doppler shift visualization.

title: COSMOS // Orbital Mechanics Lab
description: N-body gravitational simulation with planetary orbits, Lagrange points, slingshot maneuvers, and procedural space ambient synthesis.

title: ENTROPY // Cellular Automata Matrix
description: Cellular automata playground with Conway's Game of Life, Wireworld, and Langton's Ant. Emergent complexity from simple rules.

title: QUANTUM // Superposition Visualizer
description: Quantum wavefunction visualizer showing probability densities, superposition states, tunnel effect, and double-slit diffraction patterns.
